protocol:
1. Arrange the bench with a green ice bucket filled with crushed ice, colored tube racks, clear microtubes, micropipettes, and a Bio-Rad thermal cycler.

2. Select a clear microtube from the tube rack using gloved hands and hold it above the ice bucket.

3. Dispense liquid reagent into the clear microtube using a micropipette with a disposable tip.

4. Place the filled microtube onto the ice or into the nearby tube rack to keep it chilled.

5. Select another clear microtube from the rack and hold it open in one hand.

6. Dispense liquid reagent into the second clear microtube using the micropipette.

7. Place the prepared microtube into the yellow tube rack next to the ice bucket.

8. Open the lid of the Bio-Rad thermal cycler on the bench.

9. Insert a prepared microtube into the thermal cycler sample block.

10. Close the thermal cycler lid after loading the tube.

11. Retrieve chilled material from the green ice bucket using gloved fingers.

12. Handle and cap the chilled clear microtube by hand above the ice bucket.

13. Pick up a micropipette from the bench and position the disposable tip inside the clear microtube.

14. Dispense liquid reagent into the clear microtube while holding the tube above the ice bucket.

15. Pick up a Petri dish containing clear liquid medium from the bench.

16. Pipette liquid into the Petri dish using the micropipette tip while holding the dish in one hand.

17. Set the Petri dish back onto the bench and place the micropipette down next to the ice bucket.
